newsitem.title: CHINA: China targets M2 growth at 23-24 pct in 1997.
newsitem.headline: China targets M2 growth at 23-24 pct in 1997.

text.p: China has set a target of 23-24 percent growth in the broad M2 money supply this year and 18 percent for M1, the official Financial News said on Tuesday.
The newspaper, published by the central bank, repeated previous policy statements, saying the People's Bank of China would maintain its "appropriately tight" monetary policies during the year.

It said these policies were needed in the crucial year that the British colony of Hong Kong returns to Chinese rule and the Communist Party holds its 15th congress to set policies for the next five years.
Hong Kong will revert to Chinese rule at midnight on June 30.
The newspaper repeated previously announced figures of 25.3 percent growth for M2 and 18.9 percent for M1 in 1996. M1 is cash in circulation plus current deposits.
